steps.title: Workbook structure
steps.why: Separating inputs, calculations and outputs is a spreadsheet best practice: it makes models easier to check and reuse.

blocks.md:
Workbooks built with best-practice structure:

- **Inputs** hold every assumption in blue cells, named so formulas read like sentences (`=PMT(Rate/PPY, Years*PPY, -Principal)`).
- **Calculations** reference inputs by name, with no hard-coded constants.
- **Output** summarises results in bold for readers.
- **Checks** turn the tab green when everything adds up, red when something is off.
- **Changelog** records what changed and why.

Header rows are frozen and dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). The advisor runs sheet checks and points out `#REF!`, `#DIV/0!`, circular references, numbers stored as text and other common mistakes.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_ref_error}} × #REF! errors
advisor.body: A formula refers to a cell that was deleted. Fix the reference or undo the deletion.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_div0}} × Division by zero
advisor.body: A formula divides by zero or an empty cell. Wrap it in IFERROR or check that the divisor is not 0.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_circular}} × Circular references
advisor.body: A formula depends on itself. Break the loop, or turn on iterative calculation if it is intended.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_hardcoded_constant}} × Hard-coded constants
advisor.body: A number typed into a formula is easy to miss when assumptions change. A named input cell keeps it visible.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_inconsistent_formula}} × Inconsistent column formulas
advisor.body: One cell in a column uses a different formula than its neighbours, often a copy-paste slip.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_number_as_text}} × Numbers stored as text
advisor.body: Numbers stored as text are ignored by SUM and comparisons. Convert them to numbers.

advisor.title: {{metrics.lint_merged_in_data}} × Merged cells in data
advisor.body: Merged cells inside a data range break sorting and filtering. Center Across Selection gives the same look.
